notes.title: Extra Special Soup Event (Exclusive Double Feature)
notes.content:
[b]World premiere![/b]
Building on the themes and lessons learned from our previous livestream, we aim to help perpetuate your growth as a person through additional lessons in soup culture and the growth of soup as a phenomenon over the ages. We will end the livestream with a live performance testing you and showcasing all the best soup-related practices discussed (and hopefully learned!) over the week, culminating into one final soup-cooking feature! (world premiere)
